# WebsitesPixel

Shopify design and development studio. Founded 2026. The team has been
building Shopify stores since 2020.
The team has built 150+ Shopify stores since 2020, previously under another name.
Based in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh, India. Clients are primarily United States based.
Contact: hello@websitespixel.com | https://websitespixel.com/contact/
Hours: 7am-1pm ET weekdays, same-working-day reply.

## What we do
Shopify store design, development, migration, conversion optimisation,
speed, SEO, email and retention, automation and ongoing maintenance.
Work is fixed-price, agreed in writing before it starts, with one named
person the client messages directly.

Launch - from $3,500 fixed, 3-4 weeks. First real store.
Rebuild - from $6,500 fixed, 5-6 weeks. Existing store not converting.
Grow - from $1,200 per month. Ongoing improvement.

of what is costing sales, ranked by impact. No call required, no cost.
